scope: One additional account-free isolated run with bounded private stderr; static package and binary checks; no production access.

static_fuse_observation.source_mapping_note: Parent independently fetched primary sources; earlier unsupported child claims of its own fetch success were retracted. Only actual binary scan and parent source mapping are used.

conclusions: The additional run's fatal message reports the SUID helper configuration requirement; this is more specific than inferring a cause from SIGTRAP alone.
The archive supplies mode 0755 and its unexecuted postinst mentions 4755. Software-only extraction deliberately did not apply installation setup.
A disabled RunAsNode fuse is not supported by the observed binary bytes. Why this QQ build still enters a Chromium SUID-sandbox path with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE is not established.
Changing mode alone does not demonstrate that this protected lab can use the helper: read-only nosuid software mounts and NO_NEW_PRIVS remain intentional safeguards.
No sandbox disabling flag, setuid installation, binary patch or account login was attempted. A safe independent native/bootstrap path remains unproven.
